## Setup and first owner test

Only the owner should perform these explicit live actions after parent approval/deploy. Never use Simulator callbacks or forged fixtures against production.

1. Open each private control page. Confirm its named account. Status displays online/opt-in/pause, holder, subscription result, own intent status and aggregate claim counts. **Refresh status** reads local persisted state only; there is no polling or automatic networking. No session means reconnect that exact Keeper.
2. Click **Bootstrap / reconcile this channel** on each page after bot and both grants are connected. This validates that Keeper's token and bot grant, reconciles five subscriptions (online, offline, incoming/outgoing raid, chat), and backfills its own current stream through authenticated Get Streams.
